en: Sepia-toned photograph of an ornate Renaissance or early Baroque wall monument mounted between church columns. The structure is elaborately framed with scrollwork and foliage motifs, topped by the date 1524. In the lower panel a kneeling figure in prayer faces a relief of Christ or a saint above an inscribed plaque. The architecture and sculptural style suggest a Central European Catholic church interior. There is also a red handwritten signature or note along the lower right edge.
